title: Abandoned lane worktrees and loose logs are dropped or kept by decision
body:
Source: repository hygiene scan for t-vj5vfvs, 2026-11-18.
Why: abandoned lane directories hold disk and mislead `krn lane status`; none was removed because the scan could not prove each one idle.
Outcome: `ls .krn/worktrees .claude/worktrees` lists only worktrees that `git worktree list` registers with a live PID or an open PR, and `krn lane status` prints no merged or orphaned row.
Files: .krn/worktrees/screen-bwrap, .krn/worktrees/lane-install, .krn/worktrees/slot-lock-deadline, .krn/worktrees/t3g-*, .claude/worktrees/agent-a35b41d4e406bdc05, .claude/worktrees/agent-afef0ea36e486b5f5
Proof: `krn lane status` and `git worktree list` after the cleanup show none of the named directories.
Decision list: screen-bwrap is a directory git does not register (Nov 17, no process in it); t3g-*.log and t3g.patch are loose files under .krn/worktrees; lane-install is merged into main (krn lane drop); slot-lock-deadline is merged but a process still runs in it (wait); agent-a35b... is registered, at a commit already in main, 6 uncommitted entries (inspect then drop); agent-afef... is at a commit already in main with uncommitted edits to evals/replay/*.ts (the owner decides whether to keep them).
